name: cung-dang-ra-truong
description: Cùng Đăng Ra Trường — Luyện thi TOEIC & VSTEP Mobile App

scripts.copy-assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('www', {recursive:true}); ['index.html','manifest.json','sw.js','icon-192.png','icon-512.png'].forEach(f => fs.existsSync(f) && fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/' + f)); if(fs.existsSync('js')) fs.cpSync('js', 'www/js', {recursive:true}); console.log('Assets copied to www!');"
scripts.sync: npm run copy-assets && npx cap sync
scripts.open:android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
